experience.title: Principal Software Engineer
experience.location: New York, New York, United States
experience.description: As a Principal Engineer on the Menus Platform, I drive the architectural strategy for one of Toast’s most complex and high-traffic core systems. My work focuses on supporting the intricate, multi-layered configurations required by enterprise-level restaurant groups and retailers, including location-specific features and complex menu hierarchies. I lead the technical direction to ensure the platform remains highly performant under constant guest ordering load while providing a seamless, intuitive configuration experience for restaurant operators managing large-scale global deployments.

projects.name: Harmonic Accompaniment Using Machine Learning Methods
projects.description: By reading the input melody as a user plays a keyboard, and invoking a Hidden Markov Model with training data at run time, chordal accompaniment to the melody can be generated to the played melody. Success of the project judged by the audible musical consonance between the note played and the note generated.
